data.one_liner: Use an SVG file as a mask for clipping a Flutter widget.
data.what_it_does: The library provides a simple way to use an SVG file as a mask for clipping a Flutter widget. It allows you to create visually appealing designs by applying convenient shapes as masks to your widgets.
use_when: You want to clip a Flutter widget using a local SVG file shape.
You need custom non-standard widget clipping based on vector assets.
avoid_when: You need to load remote network SVGs for clipping.
You are working with complex SVGs that may not render paths correctly.
strengths: Simple API with the SvgClip widget.
weaknesses: Certain complex SVGs may not work as expected.
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec.yaml and provide local SVG assets.
data.minimal_example:
SvgClip(
  asset: ClipAsset.local(path: "assets/images/cloud.svg"),
  child: const _ColoredBox(
    color: Colors.green,
    width: 300,
    height: 100,
  ),
)
